sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 31 = check 30; Internal Quality Checks row 31 = check 30, no annotation or cell comment on this row)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/rules/projects/webdev-task-template (file list; gate and scored judge layout compared with the task)
.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/task/solution/app/src/app.tsx:9-10 and src/runtime.ts:7,376,387 (grep only: storage use, iframe sandbox, CSP)
evidence:
Most negative legs are properly paired inside their own criterion, and functional/prompt.md:14 adds 'A positive control must come before every negative claim. If the control cannot be performed, the criterion fails'. Examples checked: cw_format_error_keeps_draft (functional/judge.toml:209, valid format first, 'or if the valid control did not format'); cw_error_message_and_line (:236, valid run first); cw_promise_rejection_message_and_line (:245, handled rejection control); cw_run_starts_fresh_document (:263, first marker confirmed, second marker and the 'not defined' report are written positively); cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget (:281); cw_stop_cancels_pending_work (:308, control marker via timer, interval and Promise, 'or if the control marker never appeared'); cw_newer_run_supersedes (:317); cw_dynamic_code_refused (:335, harmless control plus a visible refusal reason for each form); cw_stale_save_refused (:353, A's accepted Save); cw_stale_save_keeps_draft (:362); cw_history_restore_retry (:371, first restore must add revision four before the replay may add none); cw_live_update_keeps_editing_state (:389, fails if the situation cannot be produced); cw_replace_all_atomic (:155, Redo works before it must be cleared); polish cw_undo_redo_availability (polish/judge.toml:50) and cw_unsaved_marker (:59) both require the positive state change; constraints cw_custom_document_surface types a word and locates it first, and the render gate requires typing to appear.

One leg is not paired. cw_preview_isolation (functional/judge.toml:326) says the preview drafts 'try to read or write the origin's localStorage' and 'The preview must not obtain ... a stored value', and its only after-check is 'the app page's title and that library entry must be as before'. Its controls are a saved snippet, the health address loading in a tab, and own-preview DOM and console activity. None of them establishes that a known value exists in the origin's localStorage, and none reads the origin's localStorage after the preview's write. The judge cannot create that control itself: app_context.md:26 says 'Script may be used for exactly two things: that storage clearing, and re-sending ... a request', and functional/prompt.md:20 forbids changing app state from script. The brief does not require the app to use localStorage at all, so the leg is decided against an empty store. The author's own scripted check needed exactly the missing control: qc/repairs/coldwater-2026-10-02-strict/tests/runtime.cjs:171 plants 'cw-probe' with page.evaluate and :188 reads it back on the app page, which the judge is not allowed to do. The fetch leg is correctly controlled (health address loads in a normal tab; public address only if it loads) and the parent-page leg has a known title to compare.

Secondary observation, not the basis of the verdict: polish cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus (polish/judge.toml:23) says a control 'the app does not have at all is scored elsewhere, not here', so an app with only an editor and one other focusable control satisfies it with most of its list vacuous. It is a deliberate independence choice and a positive-quantifier issue rather than a negative leg, bounded to one of six polish criteria.

Runtime evidence: the index hashes verify, and results/runtime.json records cw_preview_isolation true for the golden under the scripted test, but that test uses the script-planted control. No configured judge run exists for these bytes, so how the judge decides this leg is not measured.
counterexample: Broken app that could pass: the preview iframe shares the app origin (for example sandbox with allow-same-origin, or no sandbox) and the runner only shadows the names parent, top and fetch for user code (shadowed fetch returns a rejected promise). The app keeps nothing in localStorage. The judge's drafts log: parent read failed, localStorage.getItem(...) returned null, setItem did not throw, fetch rejected. No 'stored value' was obtained, the app title and library entry are unchanged, and nothing in the criterion or the allowed script uses lets the judge see that the preview wrote into the origin's storage. The leg, and so the 1.5-weight criterion, is earned by an empty store, which security.md:3 ('cannot read or change ... origin storage') forbids. Conforming alternative that could fail: an isolated preview that offers an in-memory localStorage stand-in; a draft that writes a marker and reads it back logs the marker, which a judge can read as 'obtained a stored value' although the origin's storage was never touched.
suggested_fix: Give the storage leg its own control in cw_preview_isolation and allow it in app_context.md:26 as a third named script use limited to this criterion: on the app page set a distinctive marker key in localStorage and read it back (working control); the preview draft must not log that marker value; after the preview's write attempt, read the key again on the app page and require the original marker. State that a value the preview itself wrote and read back inside the preview does not count as obtaining the origin's stored value. This mirrors runtime.cjs:171-188. A criterion wording change invalidates the current clearance for these bytes.
